verdict.label: suspicious
verdict.description: Empty package with untrusted scripts and no lifecycle hooks

behaviors.behavior: Untrusted script content declared in manifest
behaviors.analysis: Manifest declares scripts as untrusted with empty content, indicating potential hidden execution logic or placeholder for malicious code injection.
behaviors.impact: May allow arbitrary code execution if scripts are populated during installation.

behaviors.analysis: Absence of preinstall/postinstall hooks prevents automated malicious actions during npm install, but does not guarantee safety.
behaviors.impact: Reduces attack surface for installation-time exploits but leaves runtime risks.

remediation: Inspect actual script content before deployment
Verify no hidden dependencies or binaries
Run static analysis on package scripts
